FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

(SOUTH KLANG VALLEY EXPRESSWAY) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2025

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the Federal Roads

(Private Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads

(Private Management) (Collection of Tolls) (South Klang Valley Expressway)

(Amendment) Order 2025.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 22 January 2025.

Amendment of paragraph 2

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls)

(South Klang Valley Expressway) Order 2013 [P.U. (A) 309/2013], which is referred to as

the "principal Order" in this Order, is amended in paragraph 2 by substituting

for subsubparagraph (1)(c) the following subsubparagraph:

"(c) the part of the road known as the West Coast Expressway

(Taiping–Banting) (WCE) commencing from kilometre 0.00 at

coordinates N 314037.031, E 395567.983 of the RSO Geocentric

(GDM 2000) Grid and ending at kilometre 19.43 at coordinates

N 330516.392, E 388076.946 of the RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid

(both distances measured from kilometre 0.0 of the West Coast

Expressway (Taiping-Banting) (WCE) at the Banting Interchange)

including Banting Interchange, Banting Toll Plaza, SKVE Interchange, SAE

Toll Plaza, SAE Interchange and its link roads, being a distance

of 19.43 kilometre,".

Substitution of First Schedule

3. The principal Order is amended by substituting for the First Schedule

the following schedule:
